points.description: States that the connection must be two-way communication, i.e. full-duplex or semi-duplex (data flows in both directions between sender and receiver, so each side sends data frames as well as acknowledgements).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only says data goes both ways without naming duplex, or names duplex vaguely.

points.description: States that data frames must contain an additional field for the acknowledgement, so an ACK can be carried inside an outgoing data frame.
points.partial_credit: Half if it says acknowledgements are attached to data frames but does not mention the extra frame field.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both: the link must be two-way (full- or semi-duplex), and frames must have an extra acknowledgement field. The model answer joins these with "or", so a student who gives either one clearly and correctly should still get a good mark; use judgement and do not give more than 1 in total. Give part marks for vague wording such as "communication in both directions" without a clear statement. No marks for unrelated requirements such as window size or timers.
